description: I am grateful to receive the endorsement of Sussex County Councilwoman Jane Gruenebaum, who represents District 3. Jane understands the opportunities and challenges facing Sussex County, and I appreciate her confidence in my experience, commitment to education, and support for smarter growth. I look forward to partnering with her to strengthen our infrastructure, schools, environment, and communities.
